column7: 2026-11-05: Microseconds added to parse (us, µs, microsecond(s)); value is n/1000 for exact 0.5. Greek mu (U+03BC) is normalized to micro sign (U+00B5) because the /i regex matches it. My choice: format()/fmtShort/fmtLong NOT changed, so ms(0.5) still gives '0.5ms'; revisit if the user wants microsecond output.
